comparison_scope.B: strict native covered saved queries and straightforward independent exact reducer; native per-child verification
comparison_scope.C: complete research analyzer, bounded admission, exact reduction, final consumed-input union checks and publication
comparison_scope.D_checked: same Parquet path plus consumed-file SHA256 checks before/after and inventory identity; not native receipts

decision_rule: If C has no material total-time or memory advantage over applicable B/D baselines, retain correctness implementation and stop extension optimization. Do not select a favorable retrospective speed threshold.
fairness_corrections_before_repeat: All paths use one persistent Python worker per measured K prefix; C does not pay an additional Python interpreter per request.
D projects only pos, callable_depth and requested ALT; batch and fragment readahead are one, threads disabled.
Every path sees only the current sequential request. No coalescing or future-query knowledge.
Original per-member stored-locus masks apply to every path; no missing observation filled from raw data.
Telemetry parser follows native decimal-string measurements; absent peaks stay null. Failed pre-repeat remains retained separately.
held_back: workloads/held-back-v1.json remains unexecuted if the G2 stop rule applies; not used for tuning

real_saved_validation.scope: current saved-only reader/reducer against retained historical independent CIGAR oracle; not new raw extraction or new oracle execution

source_free_demo.scope: unchanged authored fixture, portable leaf verification, research manifest verification and replay with generated raw paths hidden
